source.title: Mapzen / Tilezen Terrarium mixed-source elevation tiles
source.datum: Source-dependent mixed DEM heights in metres; Web Mercator tile positioning (EPSG:3857). Consult original datasets for vertical datum and accuracy.
source.sampling: Direct RGB Terrarium decode without colour conversion; pixel-center-correct bilinear samples across tile seams into a 500 m grid.

landScreening.method: 5 × 5 samples against Natural Earth 1:110m land polygons; coarse coastline screen only, not a detailed inland-water classification.

coarse.method: 5 × 5 samples against Natural Earth 1:110m land polygons; coarse coastline screen only, not a detailed inland-water classification.

detailed.method: 65 × 65 point screen plus polygon-boundary intersections with the complete window; shared internal land-polygon edges ignored. Sample counts are not area fractions.

coverageAssessment.limitation: Natural Earth 1:10 million is generalized coastline mapping, not 10-metre resolution. Passing these checks does not verify all small water bodies, current shorelines, dry ground or field suitability.

source.caveat: Mixed elevation sources may include SRTM, USGS 3DEP/GMTED2010, Copernicus EU-DEM and NOAA bathymetry. Tile pixel spacing is not guaranteed source accuracy or effective resolution. Negative elevations are retained and are not used as an ocean classifier.
